root_cause: The independent exact-phone REVISE on the complete timed film (1b294576, 65 pages) found eight blocking defects in the renderer pictures themselves: no readable water in the opening yard, a flat brown slab with three pods where four sensors are narrated, a risk lamp and server contrast too small to read, radio rings that never travel the street under a half-mile tag, a line chart standing for the flood map with a detached rigid arm, eleven seconds of flat text cards, unfinished flat water fills, and a closing search ring visible for under half a second.
repair: Renderer-only correction on the exact current measured 59.4 s body, 64.4 s mix, 16 captions and claims 49b2379c. Replace the pictures: finished rising water with a waterline and four lit lenses at four heights, a large risk-lamp state change with a readable server contrast, rings traveling down a drawn street to a receiving point at believable scale plus a region-correct open view, a real creek and street flood map with a complete responder figure, place-anchored evidence cards instead of flat olive cards, and a held search sweep with the pinned tag attached to the map. No retiming, revoicing, script, source or caption edit.
mechanism_change: The dominant actions become drawn physical events with causal endpoints (water crossing lenses, signal reaching a receiver, flood paths on a real map) instead of labels over placeholder fills and text cards.
expected_visible_result: A muted phone viewer sees ankle-deep water in the first 1.5 s, four sensors lighting as the water rises, the risk lamp and no-server contrast read at phone size, rings reaching a receiver down the street, a flood map with creek and streets, and the limit scenes staying in a visible place.
